description: This file defines the public interface and classes for a disk cache system used in network stack implementations, including backend creation, cache entries, and file operations.

classes.name: Backend
classes.description: Interface for disk cache backend handling cache entries, statistics, and cache management.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry with methods for reading, writing, and managing cache data.

classes.name: EntryResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of opening or creating a cache entry, including success, error, or ownership transfer.

classes.name: RangeResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a range query within a cache entry.

classes.name: BackendFileOperations
classes.description: Interface for file system operations used by the cache backend.

classes.name: UnboundBackendFileOperations
classes.description: Backend file operations that are not yet bound to a specific sequence.

classes.name: BackendFileOperationsFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating backend file operations objects.

classes.name: TrivialFileOperations
classes.description: A simple implementation of BackendFileOperations using base functions.

methods.name: CreateCacheBackend
methods.description: Creates a cache backend instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadForTesting
methods.description: Flushes internal cache threads to ensure all I/O is complete.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadAsynchronouslyForTesting
methods.description: Asynchronously flushes cache threads, invoking callback when done.
